q: Village woman told women cannot contest sarpanch. What assured share exists?
expl: Constitution floor one-third; AP law raises to half.
why: Quota is floor not ceiling. AP enhanced by law.

q: 12-lakh State wants two tiers skipping middle block. Allowed?
expl: Below 20 lakh middle tier may be skipped.
why: Exception eases small States. Village base remains.

q: Towns ask where lights garbage building duties listed. Which list?
expl: Town 18; village 29 never swap.
why: Schedules split rural urban. Pair memory helps.

q: Dissolved panchayat after 4 years in Guntur. Fresh polls when?
expl: Five-year term; early dissolve repoll in six months.
why: Continuity guards democracy. Delay only narrow exception.

q: Agency elders say outsiders taking tribal land without meeting. Protection?
expl: Tribal self-rule makes Sabha supreme on land minerals.
why: Self-rule shields agency. Consent mandatory.

q: Officer says state body does Assembly polls and national body does sarpanch polls. Correct?
options: Reverse; state body does local polls
expl: State poll body does local; national does Assembly.
why: Duties divide clearly. Bandobast follows calendar.

q: Krishna district merges village town plans. Who consolidates?
expl: District body joins rural urban plans.
why: Joint view needed. Metro body for metros.

q: AP to give water health to panchayats. Which guide list?
expl: 29 guide villages; 18 guide towns.
why: Devolution follows lists. State decides depth funds.

q: Autonomous hill council claims full three-tier rules apply. Right?
expl: Certain hill areas excluded to respect autonomy.
why: Exclusion guards councils. PESA separate for agency.

q: Vijayawada big city needs town-type tag. Which fits?
expl: Corporation for large cities; council small; nagar transition.
why: Types scale with urbanisation. Vijayawada is corporation.

q: Compare village vs town lists exact pair?
expl: 29 rural vs 18 urban fixed.
why: Numbers anchors. Swap is favourite.

q: Compare poll vs money bodies for local units. Correct?
options: Polls by election body; funds by finance body
expl: Election body polls; finance advises split.
why: Jobs never overlap. One runs polls other money.

q: Compare district vs metro planning bodies. Correct?
options: District for district; metro for big city
expl: District committee district; metro for metro area.
why: Scale decides forum. Mix reflects area.

q: Compare AP 1994 law vs 1996 tribal law. Correct?
expl: General system plus agency supremacy.
why: General vs special matters. Agency stronger Sabha.

q: Compare women floor vs AP practice. Correct?
expl: Floor one-third; AP half valid extra.
why: States may exceed floor. AP did.

q: A.Village 29 subjects. B.Town 18 functions. C.Village ONLY 18 town ONLY 29.
expl: A B true; C absolute swap false.
why: Pair fixed exclusive. Only betrays trap.

q: A.Tiny may skip middle. B.5yr six-month repoll. C.Polls by money body.
expl: Exception term true; polls by election body not finance.
why: Half-truth in C role swap. Bodies separate.

q: A.AP 1994 law. B.Agency needs assembly nod. C.Hill excluded follow same tiers fully.
expl: AP PESA true; excluded exempt not full.
why: Protections create exceptions. Uniform claim fails.

q: A.Poll body local polls. B.Finance advises split. C.District body makes metro plan.
expl: First two true; metro plan is metro body not district.
why: Level matters. Metro needs own committee.

q: A.Women floor third. B.AP half. C.SC/ST linked to share.
expl: All three harmonious on representation.
why: Gender community coexist. AP extra valid.
